recipe.visualDefinition: A studio group portrait of six young men in 1960s mod attire, set against a stark white background with heavy, blocky slab-serif typography framing the top and bottom of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Typography acts as a structural frame for the central photographic subjects
High-contrast color blocking between the purple/teal text and white negative space
Layered human figures creating depth through overlapping poses
coreInvariants: 1960s-era fashion including turtlenecks, plaid jackets, and mop-top hairstyles
Flat, non-gradient color fills for text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central cluster of six figures occupying the middle 60% of the vertical space, with one figure reclining in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, purple slab-serif text at the bottom provides a heavy visual base.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the teal header, moves down through the standing figures to the seated and reclining figures, and rests on the large bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the central cluster, emphasizing the silhouette of the group.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-saturation, medium-value text colors against a high-value, low-saturation background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with square terminals
characterSpecificRedesigns: G has a sharp, inward-pointing spur
M has a deep V-shaped crotch reaching the baseline

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single word or short phrase per line

composition.overlap: Slightly behind or in front of subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monospaced slab serif family in two contrasting colors (Teal and Purple).
graphicDevices: Small metadata text at the very bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab-serif aesthetic and square terminals.
Provides the geometric, mid-century slab look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a 6-man 1960s beat group in mod clothing (turtlenecks, plaid, mop-tops) against a seamless white background. One man is reclining in the foreground, one is seated in a chair, and four are standing behind them in a tight cluster.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, uppercase slab-serif text in teal at the top and deep purple at the bottom. The text should be extra-bold and tightly spaced, framing the group.

verificationChecks: Is the clothing historically accurate to the mid-1960s?
Is the text centered and framing the subjects?

adjustableVariables: Vertical spacing between text and subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the reclining figure does not look anatomically distorted.
Check that the purple text at the bottom is significantly larger than the top text.
Verify the teal color is a distinct blue-green, not a standard primary blue.
Confirm the white background is flat and lacks shadows except under the feet.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-person mod-era studio portrait with heavy, two-color slab-serif framing on a high-key white background.
